articles.title: Dogecoin leads market rebound with 15% pump, bitcoin steady above $85,000
articles.snippet: A wave of forced buying that cost short sellers $844 million has run its course, leaving the largest cryptocurrency flat over the past hour and ZEC the only major token in the red.

articles.title: Bitcoin Breaks Out as Nasdaq Hits Records and Oil Slides on Iran Hopes
articles.snippet: A stretched but firmly bullish Bitcoin chart is riding the same tailwind lifting stocks: falling oil, a record Nasdaq, and a Fed that hiked rates while quietly pumping liquidity into the system.
